question: How many printed copies of the proposal must be submitted in the San Francisco Employees' Retirement System (SFERS) general investment consultant RFP?
gold_answer: Three (3) paper (hard) copies plus one full electronic copy.
acceptance: Three hard/paper/printed copies is fully correct. Electronic-copy mention is optional, not a required extra.
candidate_answer: Three printed (hard) copies of the proposal must be submitted. The RFP also requires one complete electronic copy. [SFERS RFP, p. 5](SFERS__SFERS-General-Investment-Consultant-RFP_vFinal.pdf#page=5)
